14	class SkillDependencyGraph:
15	    """Dependency graph helper for skill ordering and dependency injection."""
16	
17	    def __init__(self, all_skills: Dict[str, SkillMetadata]):
18	        self._all_skills = all_skills
19	        self._adj: Dict[str, Set[str]] = defaultdict(set)
20	        self._reverse: Dict[str, Set[str]] = defaultdict(set)
21	        self._build_graph()
22	
23	    def _build_graph(self) -> None:
24	        for skill_id, meta in self._all_skills.items():
25	            for dep in meta.dependencies:
26	                if dep in self._all_skills:
27	                    self._adj[skill_id].add(dep)
28	                    self._reverse[dep].add(skill_id)
29	
30	    def detect_cycles(self) -> List[List[str]]:
31	        white, gray, black = 0, 1, 2
32	        color: Dict[str, int] = {sid: white for sid in self._all_skills}
33	        path: List[str] = []
34	        cycles: List[List[str]] = []
35	
36	        def dfs(node: str) -> None:
37	            color[node] = gray
38	            path.append(node)
39	            for dep in self._adj.get(node, set()):
40	                if dep not in color:
41	                    continue
42	                if color[dep] == gray:
43	                    cycle_start = path.index(dep)
44	                    cycles.append(path[cycle_start:] + [dep])
45	                elif color[dep] == white:
46	                    dfs(dep)
47	            path.pop()
48	            color[node] = black
49	
50	        for skill_id in self._all_skills:
51	            if color[skill_id] == white:
52	                dfs(skill_id)
53	        return cycles

55	    def get_required_deps(self, skill_ids: List[str]) -> List[str]:
56	        selected = set(skill_ids)
57	        missing: List[str] = []
58	        for skill_id in skill_ids:
59	            for dep in self._adj.get(skill_id, set()):
60	                if dep not in selected and dep not in missing:
61	                    missing.append(dep)
62	        return missing

64	    def topological_sort(self, skill_ids: List[str]) -> Tuple[List[str], List[str]]:
65	        selected = set(skill_ids)
66	        in_degree: Dict[str, int] = {sid: 0 for sid in selected}
67	        for skill_id in selected:
68	            for dep in self._adj.get(skill_id, set()):
69	                if dep in selected:
70	                    in_degree[skill_id] += 1
71	
72	        queue = deque([sid for sid, degree in in_degree.items() if degree == 0])
73	        ordered: List[str] = []
74	
75	        while queue:
76	            node = queue.popleft()
77	            ordered.append(node)
78	            for dependent in self._reverse.get(node, set()):
79	                if dependent not in in_degree:
80	                    continue
81	                in_degree[dependent] -= 1
82	                if in_degree[dependent] == 0:
83	                    queue.append(dependent)
84	
85	        excluded = [sid for sid in skill_ids if sid not in ordered]
86	        if excluded:
87	            logger.warning("Cycle detected in skill dependencies; excluding %s", excluded)
88	        return ordered, excluded
